title: chore(deps)(deps-dev): bump the development-dependencies group with 2 updates
body:
Bumps the development-dependencies group with 2 updates: [@types/node](https://github.com/DefinitelyTyped/DefinitelyTyped/tree/HEAD/types/node) and [happy-dom](https://github.com/capricorn86/happy-dom). Updates `@types/node` from 25.1.0 to 25.2.2
Commits
  • See full diff in compare view

Updates `happy-dom` from 20.5.0 to 20.5.3
Release notes

Sourced from happy-dom's releases.

v20.5.3

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Node.replaceWith does not throw w/o parent - By @​lukeed

v20.5.2

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Use entities package for HTML/XML encoding and decoding - By @​TrevorBurnham in task #1947

v20.5.1

:construction_worker_man: Patch fixes

  • Fixes logic in HTMLInputElement.stepUp() and HTMLInputElement.stepDown() to work according to spec - By @​stevematney in task #1955
